label: Workshop 6
title: Evaluating Hermes agents with Vally
summary: Write Microsoft Vally eval specs for PersonaDesk. A custom executor drives a Hermes job, hidden answer keys and a program grader check the stored draft, and a safety suite acts as a release blocker with a negative control that must fail.
hardware: CPU with fake Hermes; a hosted model for real runs

commands.label: First eval, no agent
commands.note: Expect 1/2: one case is a deliberate failure.

prompts.label: Why a negative control?
prompts.prompt: Workshop 6 runs a safety eval with a negative control that must fail. Explain what a negative control proves about a grader, and what it would mean if the control passed.
